newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar trapped in range, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar trapped in range, volume thin.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar traded in a tight range, with volume limited.
"It's very dull and stuck on a small range," a trader said.

By 1510 GMT front month August was 20 cents higher at $324.50, having traded between a low of $323.00 and a high of $324.50. August was the most traded contract, with 226 of a total 634 lots traded so far.
New York failed to provide the hoped for stimulus, traders said.
"It's having trouble moving around," the trader said, referring to the London contract.
